description: Compressed key ranges at c128 (production ratio, topk 64, input topk width 256 > topk): topk_len boundary at (pos+1)%128==0 including pos==c_max*128-1 and ==c_max*128; -1 entries inside the valid prefix; nonzero query_start_loc base (cross-chunk offset rebase, utils docstring 'query_start_loc can include a cross-chunk offset'); SWA segment rebasing into the flat workspace.
